before.stem: A70 year old undergoes radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer. Postoperatively he complains of urinary incontinence due to paralysis of the external urethral sphincter. Which of the following nerves was most likely injured during surgery:

after.stem: A 70-year-old man undergoes radical prostatectomy for prostate cancer. Postoperatively, he has urinary incontinence due to paralysis of the external urethral sphincter. Which nerve was most likely injured?

evidence.externalFinding: The deep perineal branch innervates the external urethral sphincter.

before.stem: w The abdominal aorta bifurcates into its terminal branches at which of the following vertebral levels:

after.stem: The abdominal aorta bifurcates into its terminal branches at which vertebral level?

evidence.externalFinding: The abdominal aorta bifurcates at L4.

Which of the following structures has most likely been injured:

after.stem: A 49-year-old woman undergoes surgery for uterine cancer. During uterine-artery ligation, the surgeon injures the structure that the artery crosses anteriorly. Which structure was injured?

evidence.externalFinding: The uterine artery crosses the ureter 1 cm lateral to the internal os.

before.stem: Sensation to the skin over the penis is primarily supplied by which of the following nerves:

evidence.externalFinding: The dorsal nerve is a solely cutaneous pudendal branch supplying shaft and glans.
